summaries.title: Adapting General Disentanglement-Based Speaker Anonymization for Enhanced Emotion Preservation
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**多模态与统一基座**（Multimodal）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「安全对齐脆弱性、隐私版权与潜在失控风险」痛点，作者围绕 **Adapting General Disentanglement-Based Speaker Anonymization** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖多模态与统一基座（Multimodal）。核心论点主张：This paper explores how to adapt such a system when a new speech attribute, for example, emotion, needs to be preserved to a greater extent。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：While existing systems are good at anonymizing speaker embeddings, they are not designed to preserve emotion。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（First, we show that integrating emotion embeddings from a pre-trained emotion encoder can help preserve emotional cues, even though this approach slightly compromises privacy protection）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 6 赞），本工作为突破 **多模态与统一基座** 中的「安全对齐脆弱性、隐私版权与潜在失控风险」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。
